name: Bab Tuma
text: Bab Tuma (Arabic: بَابُ تُومَا, romanized: Bāb Tūmā, meaning: "Gate of Thomas") is a neighborhood located in the old city of Damascus in Syria. It is named after one of the seven gates of old city of Damascus, located within the neighbourhood.

depictions.name: Bab Tuma
depictions.text: Bab Tuma The Bab Tuma (English: Gate of Thomas) is the northeastern gate of the Old City of Damascus.
